rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for referring to the act of vomiting.

example.english: After eating at the buffet, I felt like I was going to vomit all night.
example.traditional: 食完自助餐之後，我成晚都想嘔。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 zi6 zo6 caan1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 soeng2 au2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the material that has been vomited, rather than the act itself.

example.english: The medical staff examined the vomit first and then worked out what the patient had eaten.
example.traditional: 醫護人員先檢查嘔吐物，再判斷病人食過乜嘢。
example.jyutping: ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 sin1 gim2 caa4 au2 tou3 mat6 zoi3 pun3 dyun3 beng6 jan4 sik6 gwo3 mat1 je5
